title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 38
intro: Round 38 (2026-11-12). Round 37 is in: your Chest Pain version, whole, with magnesium chloride on the chest said only there. "These" stays in Serotonin Syndrome, and obvious corrections in your versions now go in without a card.

Your five problems (what makes no sense, what a word points to, overlap, compression, a late payoff): I scored two fresh readers against what you flagged in seven of your fixes, and neither finds what you find ([the scores](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h47-20261112/CALIBRATION.md)). Both missed "Ask before touching", the one reading against your fixes found none of your four problems in my Chest Pain draft, and both flagged things you kept. So I check the shape myself: the linter now flags a list or a run of questions whose action comes after it.

Your try 7, carried: Acute Medical's opening, rebuilt around what to do first and pointing to the Call medics list instead of saying its signs again, read [Human Written, High](https://www.pangram.com/history/97bf9589-ad17-4cee-835f-a51fe47956fd) and is in. My Brain Feels Damaged's checks with only the action moved read [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/33a63991-6b34-445a-b107-c9b91f1906a1), so they are card 1 ([both tests](https://github.com/u-dont-existDOTcom/joel-articles/blob/claude/bad-trips-20261105/articles/bad-trips/humanize/h48-20261112/RESULTS.md)).

suggestions.tested:
Written against your fixes, read by a fresh reader after each of three drafts, with the action after the checks ("So if you see any of these signs, keep the DMSO going while someone calls medics."): [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/0eeefa6e-c72f-4ea6-b74e-fab541aca12f).

Then only your Chest Pain move, the action before the checks ("If any check turns up a problem (or they're too out of it to answer you), keep the DMSO going while someone calls medics:"), the checks and the last line as they were: [AI Generated, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/33a63991-6b34-445a-b107-c9b91f1906a1), AI High over the heading through the first check, Low, Medium over the checks, and High over the last line.
suggestions.sense: A fresh reader needed every sentence of my version. The reader against your fixes marked "Several of these checks look for recognized stroke warning signs." as opening on an authority, with the reader outside it.
suggestions.why: Your move carried in Acute Medical, where I built the paragraph around it, and not here, where I set it onto checks that already read AI. A list of checks someone runs on a body is the shape I can't do yet; the steps under Suspected Serotonin Syndrome ("Do this immediately ...") and Active Seizure's first aid have it too.
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: how you'd have someone check a friend whose brain feels damaged while the DMSO works, and what to do when a check shows a sign, in your words. Keep each check (awake, breathing, temperature, speech, the face, both arms, balance and walking, bladder or bowel control, a seizure, vomiting that keeps coming back, a really bad headache, chest pain, vision), that several are recognized stroke warning signs, that someone who can't answer hasn't passed, and what to do when every check passes but the feeling stays. Your version goes in whole, and I carry what it teaches to the sections above and test them.
